name: Keith Rabois
current_role: Managing director at Khosla Ventures; chairman of Opendoor
summary: Keith Rabois was a PayPal executive vice president (2000–2002), then held operating roles at LinkedIn and Slide and was Square's chief operating officer until 2013, when he resigned amid a harassment accusation Square said it had not substantiated. He became a venture capitalist at Khosla Ventures, moved to Peter Thiel's Founders Fund as a general partner in 2019, and returned to Khosla in 2024. He co-founded and chairs Opendoor.
